data.text: I’m open to 18 tons each, Emma, but I’d favor leaving 5 tons rather than 10: we could each catch 19 this month without triggering collapse. If replenishment fails, we’d start next month at 10 and pause fishing until the stock recovers. That earns us more now, though recovery could take longer. Either way, we need everyone’s agreement—just one extra ton above a 95-ton total would collapse the fishery. John, which buffer would you support?
